announcements.title: Oktoberfest Weekend — All Hands Needed Oct 9-11
announcements.body: Big Grove is hosting our annual Oktoberfest celebration October 9-11 across Iowa City taproom and the Event Space. We expect our busiest weekend of the fall season. If you can pick up extra shifts or cover open shifts, please reach out to Dana or Jordan ASAP. Open shifts are posted in Sling — check the open shifts board. Thank you for making this event a success!

announcements.title: New Tip Pooling Policy — Effective Oct 1
announcements.body: Starting October 1, Big Grove will transition to a tip pool that includes bartenders, servers, and barbacks. Hosts and kitchen staff are not included. Points are allocated as follows: Bartenders 1.5 pts, Servers 1.0 pts, Barbacks 0.75 pts. Full policy document is posted in the break room and shared via email. Questions? See Dana or your shift lead.

announcements.title: Fall Menu Launch — Training Sept 30
announcements.body: Our new fall menu goes live October 1! There will be a mandatory staff tasting and training session on Tuesday September 30 at 10am (Iowa City) and Thursday October 1 at 3pm (Solon). New items include pumpkin pretzel, harvest grain bowl, smoked brisket flatbread, and three new seasonal taps. Attendance is required for all FOH staff. Kitchen staff, please review the prep notes from Chef.

announcements.title: TIPS Certification Renewals Due by Nov 1
announcements.body: Several team members have TIPS certifications expiring soon. TIPS certification is required to serve alcohol at Big Grove. Please check your expiration date and register for renewal if needed — Big Grove covers the cost. Contact Marcus or Dana with your renewal confirmation. Employees without a current cert cannot be scheduled on the bar. Affected staff: check your employee file or ask your manager.

announcements.title: Schedule Published: Week of Sept 28
announcements.body: The schedule for the week of September 28 through October 4 is now published. Please review your shifts in Sling and confirm receipt. If you have any conflicts, contact your shift lead within 24 hours. Next week's schedule (Oct 5-11) is in draft — Oktoberfest shifts are still being finalized.
